_about: The behavioral question bank, reviewed and approved 2026-10-12. Three layers: universal (everyone), people (managers and up), business (senior leaders). Each competency's first question is the one a light or medium deck uses; heavy uses all. tone: positive asks about a success, negative about a failure or a hard moment. Use the wording as written.

competencies.title: Work Ethic and Ownership
competencies.tests: You do what you said, and own what's yours.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you failed to meet a deadline.
Tell me about a time you went beyond what your role required to get something done.
Tell me about a problem you took on that nobody else was handling.

competencies.title: Collaboration
competencies.tests: You make the people around you more effective.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you helped a teammate succeed.
Tell me about a time you worked with someone you found difficult.
Tell me about a time you put a personal interest aside to help a group.

competencies.title: Communication
competencies.tests: People understand you, and you understand them.

questions.text: Tell me about a time a miscommunication caused a problem.
Tell me about a time you explained something complex to someone without your background.

competencies.title: Problem Solving
competencies.tests: You work out what's actually wrong, then fix it.

questions.text: Tell me about a problem you solved that others had given up on.
Tell me about a time your first solution didn't work.

competencies.title: Decision Making and Judgment
competencies.tests: You make good calls, including under uncertainty.

questions.text: Tell me about a decision you made with incomplete information.
Tell me about a decision you got wrong.
Tell me about a time you decided not to act.

competencies.title: Adaptability
competencies.tests: You keep delivering when the plan changes.

questions.text: Tell me about a time your priorities changed overnight.
Tell me about a change you resisted at first.

competencies.title: Conflict
competencies.tests: You can disagree and keep the working relationship.

questions.text: Tell me about a disagreement with your manager.
Tell me about a time you resolved a conflict between other people.
Tell me about a conflict you didn't handle well.

competencies.title: Learning from Failure and Feedback
competencies.tests: You get better because of what goes wrong.

questions.text: Tell me about your biggest professional failure.
Tell me about feedback that was hard to hear.
Tell me about something you taught yourself to do your job better.
Tell me about a time you delivered under real pressure.
Tell me about a time you had too much on your plate and something slipped.

competencies.title: Integrity
competencies.tests: You do the right thing when it costs you something.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you were asked to do something you thought was wrong.
Tell me about a time you delivered news nobody wanted to hear.
Tell me about a mistake you made that nobody else noticed. What did you do?
Tell me about someone you developed who went on to bigger things.
Tell me about someone you couldn't help improve.
Tell me about your best hire, and how you knew they were the right fit.
Tell me about a hire that didn't work out.

competencies.title: Hard People Decisions
competencies.tests: You act on performance, and do it humanely.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to let someone go.
Tell me about a time tough feedback turned someone's performance around.

competencies.title: Building a Team
competencies.tests: You shape a team that works.

questions.text: Tell me about a team you built or rebuilt.
Tell me about a time your team missed a goal.

competencies.title: Humility
competencies.tests: You can be wrong in front of the people you lead.

questions.text: Tell me about a time someone on your team was right and you were wrong.
Tell me about a time you changed your mind because of someone who reported to you.
Tell me about a leadership habit you've had to unlearn.

competencies.title: Influence without Authority
competencies.tests: You move decisions you don't own.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you changed a decision that wasn't yours to make.
Tell me about a time you couldn't win people over.

competencies.title: Strategy
competencies.tests: You set direction and see whether it worked.

questions.text: Tell me about a strategic bet that didn't pay off.
Tell me about a strategy you set and how it played out.

competencies.title: Leading Change
competencies.tests: You take people through change that sticks.

questions.text: Tell me about the biggest change you've led.
Tell me about a change effort that stalled.

competencies.title: Working with Executives
competencies.tests: You earn trust at the top, and push back when it matters.

questions.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with an executive and lost.
Tell me about a time you pushed back on a senior leader and it changed the outcome.
